messages.content:
Generate only:
escape_markdown_text(value: str) -> str

Require a str and reject other types with ValueError. Escape backslash first, then Markdown-special characters *, _, backtick, [, ], (, ), and # by prefixing each with one backslash. Preserve all other characters, including newlines and Unicode; do not HTML-escape or trim. Deterministic; no filesystem/network/global state. Example: "bad_[x]*" -> "bad\\_\\[x\\]\\*". Return only Python artifact.
